title: Check out my online multiplayer card game demo
author: Wallstreetking1
selftext: hey guys, I built a rock paper scissors RPG online multiplayer card game. this is a prototype for something bigger and better, but it's a start. let me know what you think. I would love some feedback. all features do current work, I do need to make some tweaks, and the Google sign up is giving me some issues, but playing as a guest works fine.
